# PDF browser libraries

These pinned browser bundles are served locally, so exporting a PDF needs no external service or CDN.

- `pdf-lib.min.js`: pdf-lib 1.17.1, MIT license in `pdf-lib.LICENSE.md`.
- `fontkit.min.js`: @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1, MIT license in `fontkit.LICENSE.md`.

After updating the pinned npm packages, run `npm run vendor:pdf` to refresh these files.
